task: Task S / Jiyong / independent original-source ARTEMIS audit
scope: All nine ARTEMIS_* rows only; no other polar sites

publication.title: Assessing Potential Landing Sites With Favorable Illumination and Accessible, Potentially Volatile-Rich Permanently Shadowed Regions Within Artemis Candidate Landing Regions
publication.version: Published journal article / publisher-formatted version with ETH generated cover
publication.version_evidence: ETH cover identifies original journal, volume/issue and DOI; following page has matching title/authors/DOI, journal layout, accepted date 8 FEB 2026, copyright 2026, article pagination 1 of 34; journal pages carry Wiley download footer dated 11/03/2026. No byte-identity claim against blocked direct Wiley download.

additional_retrieval_channels.status: full HTML readable; HTTP status/raw bytes not exposed
additional_retrieval_channels.observation: Table A1 rows independently read with visible minus signs; agrees with downloaded ETH publisher PDF.

additional_retrieval_channels.status: 34-page PDF text readable; screenshot calls returned references but no image bytes exposed in tool wrapper
additional_retrieval_channels.observation: PDF page locators agree with ETH copy, with one extra ETH cover page.

method: Read AGENTS.md, data contract, and current catalogue. No previous audit conclusions used as evidence.
Attempted original source directly; saved 403 response bytes and metadata, separate from actual evidence.
Retrieved ETH published PDF through /bitstreams/.../download; it redirected to /server/api/core/bitstreams/.../content with HTTP 200 after earlier HTTP 429 attempts.
Matched title and DOI on ETH cover and journal first page; viewed both.
Read Table A1 and independently viewed PyMuPDF renders of ETH PDF pages 26–28, corresponding to article pages 25–27.
Compared exact signed decimal strings using Decimal; all nine numeric values match.
rendering_warning: System Poppler emitted missing-font warnings and visibly omitted some minus/leading digits in its PNGs. Those renders are not evidence; verified-page-*.png were independently generated by PyMuPDF and all selected coordinates were visually confirmed.

rows.source_hemisphere_notation: Signed latitude/longitude; no printed N/S/E/W suffixes. Negative latitude is south; negative longitude is west under east-positive interpretation.
rows.access_status: HTTP 200 published PDF; original direct Wiley request HTTP 403, original Wiley HTML/PDF readable through web retrieval

visual_evidence.method: PyMuPDF render at 1.5 scale, independently viewed; negative glyph and all digits confirmed

rows.coordinate_role: Manually selected representative candidate landing site (research CLS) within the candidate landing region; not the NASA region centre or a NASA-selected touchdown point.
rows.role_evidence_locator: Section 3 (Candidate Landing Sites), article p. 6, and Table A1
rows.frame_limitation: Paper gives geographic coordinates and uses LRO imagery/LOLA DEMs; inspected table and text do not explicitly establish MOON_ME_DE421, planetocentric latitude, or a datum transformation. No frame conversion performed.
rows.precision_limitation: Table prints four fractional digits, with a trailing zero in each selected value. This is numerical representation, not a stated accuracy/uncertainty. Representative research sites are not surveyed landing locations.
rows.normalization: Signed degrees copied without coordinate transformation; trailing zeros may be omitted by JSON numeric serialization.
rows.recommended_action: retain coordinate; preserve research CLS role and frame/precision caveat
